Calcite nightly, DATE

A Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 server written from scratch in Calx (https://calcitemc.com).
Built from https://github.com/ellipog/calcite/commit/COMMIT
with Calx at https://github.com/ellipog/calx/commit/CALX

This is a development build: the newest commit on main whose tests passed, and tested no further.
Back up a world before you open it with this build.

To run it, start the server in the folder you want its files in:

    Windows:  calcite.exe
    Linux:    ./calcite

The first time, it writes server.properties and calcite.properties, and reads vanilla's data from
Minecraft's client jar: from the game if a launcher has installed 26.3, or else by downloading the
part of the jar that holds it from Mojang. The whitelist is on, as vanilla's is by default. The
guide: https://calcitemc.com/docs/start

Calcite is source-available under the Business Source License 1.1, in LICENSE, with NOTICE. You may
run it for free on your own servers, commercial ones included. Offering it to others as a hosting
service needs a host license, which is free for now:
https://github.com/ellipog/calcite/blob/main/docs/hosting.md

Calcite contains no Mojang code or assets. Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or
associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
